summary: Security-fix verification for EGMG backend + frontend regression. 29 backend pytest tests written, 29/29 passing after fixing brute-force test to hit localhost (proxy varies request.client.host so public URL doesn't accumulate lockout counter). Auth gating on /api/contacts and /api/bookings works (401 unauth, 200 with Bearer). Login sets HttpOnly+Secure access_token/refresh_token cookies. Article Pydantic validators reject javascript:, data:, non-embed video hosts (422); accept https youtube.com/embed, /api/uploads/ paths, https pdf URLs. Upload endpoint enforces magic-byte check (fake .png → 400), blocks .exe/.svg (400), requires auth (401), real PNG served with content-type image/png + X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Regex search escape works (<2s for (a+)+$). CORS on localhost blocks evil.example origin and allows configured preview origin with credentials. Public /api/contact, /api/bookings, /api/articles work. Frontend admin login → dashboard → create article with bad video URL rejected (422, error shown) → create with valid YouTube embed succeeds → cleanup done. /media renders 18 articles. /contact page loads with correct data-testids. No critical console errors.

minor.issue: Rate-limit identifier uses request.client.host which under the preview proxy is not stable per client. On the public URL 6+ wrong attempts still return 401 (never 429). Localhost works correctly. Recommend trusting X-Forwarded-For (first hop) behind proxy for meaningful rate limiting.

ui_bugs.issue: Save error is a generic 'Failed to create article.' — does not surface backend 422 field-level detail (e.g., invalid video URL). Users cannot tell which field failed validation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Trust X-Forwarded-For header (or use starlette ProxyHeaders) so login brute-force lockout works behind the preview/production proxy.

OPTIONAL: In AdminDashboardPage.handleSave, surface backend err.response.data.detail (or first Pydantic error msg) instead of the generic 'Failed to create article.' string, so admins get actionable feedback on invalid URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_articles regex uses re.escape on user input and caps to 100 chars — safe against ReDoS.
validate_media_url rejects any scheme other than http/https (and /api/uploads/ paths) — data:, javascript:, file: all rejected.
Upload magic-byte check is enforced BEFORE persistence; SVG is not in MAGIC_BYTES so uploads correctly return 400.
COOKIE_SECURE default True; login/refresh cookies confirmed HttpOnly and Secure via raw localhost response.
CORSMiddleware allow_credentials tied to non-wildcard origins — good; explicit allowlist from env.
Admin seed skipped safely when ADMIN_PASSWORD missing/<12 chars; rotates hash if env differs.
MINOR: /api/uploads/{filename} stores base64 in Mongo — fine for a small CMS but not ideal at scale; consider GridFS or object storage.

MINOR: `login_attempts.locked_until` doubles as both counter and lockout window — successful next window still requires the 15-min wait even after the first wrong attempt because upsert always sets locked_until. Consider only setting locked_until once count reaches 5.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ articles created during tests were deleted; TEST_ contact/booking rows from public-flow tests were cleaned up via a one-shot script before frontend testing (42 stale rows removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend security fixes verified end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py is a reusable regression. Note: the preview proxy rewrites Set-Cookie (adds Partitioned, SameSite=None) and may mask CORS headers — always test raw CORS + cookie flags against http://localhost:8001. Brute-force lockout does NOT function on the public URL due to shared/unstable proxy IPs; unless the app is updated to trust X-Forwarded-For, testers must exercise the lockout logic against localhost.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regressions found. The only observed deviation is the brute-force lockout being effectively bypassable through the preview proxy because request.client.host resolves to a rotating/unstable proxy IP. Mitigation: read the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For (leftmost address) or configure Starlette's ProxyHeadersMiddleware/UvicornProxyHeaders with trusted proxies.
